connectorExamples.english: Get up as early as eight / not get up until eight.

connectorExamples.hanzi: 我每天早上都在家做早饭。
connectorExamples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang dōu zài jiā zuò zǎofàn.
connectorExamples.english: I make breakfast at home every morning.

connectorExamples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí zài jiā zuò zǎofàn.
connectorExamples.english: I’ve been making breakfast at home all along.

trends.english: The subway station is getting more crowded.

trends.pinyin: Wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐhuan Zhōngwén.
trends.english: I like Chinese more and more.

trends.hanzi: 人们越来越离不开手机。
trends.pinyin: Rénmen yuè lái yuè lí bu kāi shǒujī.
trends.english: People increasingly can’t do without their phones.

relationships.hanzi: 人越多，越容易撞到别人。
relationships.pinyin: Rén yuè duō, yuè róngyì zhuàngdào biérén.
relationships.english: The more people there are, the easier it is to bump into someone.
The more he eats, the heavier he gets.

relationships.pinyin: Nǐ yuè shuō, wǒ yuè bù míngbai.
relationships.english: The more you talk, the less I understand.

variants.note: The two changing parts can be adjectives. The subject can be omitted when the context is clear.

variants.hanzi: 越是着急，越是容易出错。
variants.pinyin: Yuè shì zháojí, yuè shì róngyì chūcuò.
variants.english: The more rushed you are, the more easily you make mistakes.
variants.note: 越是…越是… is an emphatic variant.
愈…愈… is a written or formal variant.

variants.hanzi: 人越来越多，越挤越容易撞到别人。
variants.pinyin: Rén yuè lái yuè duō, yuè jǐ yuè róngyì zhuàngdào biérén.
variants.english: There are more and more people. The more crowded it gets, the easier it is to bump into someone.
variants.note: Both patterns can occur in the same situation.

reading.hanzi: 今天我想说一说一边走路一边看手机的危险。
reading.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ xiǎng shuō yi shuō yìbiān zǒulù yìbiān kàn shǒujī de wēixiǎn.
reading.english: Today I’d like to talk about the dangers of looking at your phone while walking.

reading.hanzi: 什么东西都有好处，也有坏处。
reading.pinyin: Shénme dōngxi dōu yǒu hǎochu, yě yǒu huàichu.

reading.hanzi: 现代生活，人们越来越离不开手机。
reading.pinyin: Xiàndài shēnghuó, rénmen yuèláiyuè líbukāi shǒujī.
reading.english: In modern life, people rely more and more on their phones.

reading.hanzi: 坐地铁需要手机，打的需要手机，买东西需要手机。
reading.pinyin: Zuò dìtiě xūyào shǒujī, dǎdī xūyào shǒujī, mǎi dōngxi xūyào shǒujī.
reading.english: We need our phones to take the subway, get a taxi, and shop.

reading.hanzi: 一方面，手机给我们的生活带来了好处。
reading.pinyin: Yì fāngmiàn, shǒujī gěi wǒmen de shēnghuó dàilái le hǎochu.
reading.english: On the one hand, phones have made our lives better in some ways.

reading.hanzi: 另一方面，手机也带来了很多坏处。
reading.pinyin: Lìng yì fāngmiàn, shǒujī yě dàilái le hěn duō huàichu.
reading.english: On the other hand, phones have also brought many problems.

reading.hanzi: 在很多地方，比如在地铁站、在路上、在火车站、在超市，我们都能看到很多年轻人一边走路，一边玩手机。
reading.pinyin: Zài hěn duō dìfang, bǐrú zài dìtiězhàn, zài lùshang, zài huǒchēzhàn, zài chāoshì, wǒmen dōu néng kàndào hěn duō niánqīngrén yìbiān zǒulù, yìbiān wán shǒujī.
reading.english: In many places, such as subway stations, streets, train stations, and supermarkets, we see lots of young people using their phones while walking.

reading.hanzi: 出门在外，一边走路一边看手机，很容易撞到别人。
reading.pinyin: Chūmén zàiwài, yìbiān zǒulù yìbiān kàn shǒujī, hěn róngyì zhuàngdào biérén.
reading.english: When you’re out and about, it’s easy to bump into someone if you look at your phone while walking.

reading.hanzi: 在商场、学校、公园或者地铁站，人一多，就更容易撞到别人。
reading.pinyin: Zài shāngchǎng, xuéxiào, gōngyuán huòzhě dìtiězhàn, rén yì duō, jiù gèng róngyì zhuàngdào biérén.
reading.english: In malls, schools, parks, or subway stations, it’s even easier to bump into someone when it gets crowded.

reading.hanzi: 如果一直盯着手机屏幕，就容易忽略周围的情况。
reading.pinyin: Rúguǒ yìzhí dīngzhe shǒujī píngmù, jiù róngyì hūlüè zhōuwéi de qíngkuàng.
reading.english: If you keep staring at your phone screen, it’s easy to miss what’s happening around you.

reading.hanzi: 有时候会撞到门或者别的东西，也可能掉进坑里，或者从楼梯上摔下来。
reading.pinyin: Yǒushíhou huì zhuàngdào mén huòzhě bié de dōngxi, yě kěnéng diàojìn kēng li, huòzhě cóng lóutī shang shuāi xiàlai.
reading.english: Sometimes you walk into a door or another object. You might also fall into a hole or tumble down the stairs.

reading.hanzi: 有些小意外挺好笑的，有些却很危险。
reading.pinyin: Yǒuxiē xiǎo yìwài tǐng hǎoxiào de, yǒuxiē què hěn wēixiǎn.
reading.english: Some little mishaps are pretty funny, while others are dangerous.

reading.hanzi: 因为路上有很多汽车，电动车开得很快，如果你玩手机，就注意不到危险，很容易发生交通事故。
reading.pinyin: Yīnwèi lùshang yǒu hěn duō qìchē, diàndòngchē kāi de hěn kuài, rúguǒ nǐ wán shǒujī, jiù zhùyì bu dào wēixiǎn, hěn róngyì fāshēng jiāotōng shìgù.
reading.english: There are lots of cars on the road, and electric scooters go fast. If you’re on your phone, you won’t notice the danger, and a traffic accident can easily happen.

caution.hanzi: 我们在外面的时候要小心。
caution.pinyin: Wǒmen zài wàimiàn de shíhou yào xiǎoxīn.
caution.english: We need to be careful when we’re out.

caution.hanzi: 我们在超市的时候，人一多，就要小心。
caution.pinyin: Wǒmen zài chāoshì de shíhou, rén yì duō, jiù yào xiǎoxīn.
caution.english: When it gets crowded at the supermarket, we need to be careful.

caution.hanzi: 如果不小心，就容易撞到别人。
caution.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù xiǎoxīn, jiù róngyì zhuàngdào biérén.
caution.english: If we aren’t careful, it’s easy to bump into someone.

caution.hanzi: 在人多的地方要小心，不然容易撞到别人。
caution.pinyin: Zài rén duō de dìfang yào xiǎoxīn, bùrán róngyì zhuàngdào biérén.
caution.english: Be careful in crowded places, or you might bump into someone.

caution.hanzi: 边走边看手机的时候，我们要小心。
caution.pinyin: Biān zǒu biān kàn shǒujī de shíhou, wǒmen yào xiǎoxīn.
caution.english: When we look at our phones while walking, we need to be careful.

caution.hanzi: 不小心的话，就容易撞到别人。
caution.pinyin: Bù xiǎoxīn de huà, jiù róngyì zhuàngdào biérén.
caution.english: If you aren’t careful, you might bump into someone.

caution.hanzi: 我们每次去人多的地方，如果边走边看手机，就要小心，不然容易撞到别人。
caution.pinyin: Wǒmen měicì qù rén duō de dìfang, rúguǒ biān zǒu biān kàn shǒujī, jiù yào xiǎoxīn, bùrán róngyì zhuàngdào biérén.
caution.english: Whenever we go somewhere crowded, we need to be careful if we use our phones while walking, or we might bump into someone.
